Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_TilesPerMinute_t: How many random tiles to clean per in-game minute.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_WeatherThreshold: How heavy the rain or snow must be before blood starts washing away. Higher = needs heavier weather.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanAsh_too: Also clean ash left behind by burned corpses.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanVehicle: Also gradually clean blood from vehicles.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_VehicleCleanSpee: How much blood to remove from vehicles per minute.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_AlsoCleanClothes: Also gradually clean blood and dirt from players' worn clothing.
Sandbox_RainCleansBlood_ClothesCleanSpee: How much blood and dirt to remove from clothing per minute.
